# Planroom block catalog

Every block is sent as `{ "type": "doc.block.upsert", "block": { "id", "type", "config", "caption"?, "refs"? } }` and placed
in the write-up by a section that lists its id: `{ "type": "doc.section.upsert", "section": { "id", "title", "order", "blocks": [ids] } }`.
Send a block before, or in the same batch as, the section that lists it. A block in a question's `context.blocks` or a `comment.reply`'s `blocks` has no `id`.

- An entry in a section's `blocks` can be a list of two or three ids instead of one: those blocks sit side by side as columns, and
  stack on a narrow screen. `"blocks": ["how-text", ["how-before", "how-after"], "how-seq"]` puts two diagrams next to each other.
- `refs` are the question ids the block came from (`["Q-12"]`); the page links them.
- Text in any config is shown as text. Never send HTML: it is displayed literally.
- Diagrams take nodes and edges only; the page lays them out. Chart colours come from the page, never from you.
- A config that fails its schema is still stored and shown as an error card, and `planroom_emit` lists it in `blockProblems`
  with each field path. Fix it in place: re-send a write-up block with the same `id`, a question's context with `question.upsert`,
  and a reply's blocks with `{ "type": "comment.edit", "messageId": "C-1.2", "blocks": [...] }`, the message id `blockProblems` names.

## text

**Text.** Prose: a paragraph, a bullet list, a short summary. The only block that carries free text.

- A markdown subset: paragraphs, `-` and `1.` lists, **bold**, *italic*, `inline code` and links. HTML is shown as literal text.
- Mention question ids (`Q-12`) in the text and the page links them.

Example config:

```json
{
  "body": "- A new **limiter middleware** checks a per-key token bucket in Redis before any handler runs.\n- Over-limit calls get `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`.\n- If Redis is unreachable we **fail open** and page on-call (Q-12)."
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"body":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40000}},"required":["body"]}
```

## callout

**Callout.** A decision, assumption, note or risk worth pulling out. A write-up `assumption` callout gets Confirm and Correct buttons and counts against the submit gate until confirmed.

- tone: note | decision | assumption | risk
- Put the question ids it came from in the envelope `refs`.

Example config:

```json
{
  "tone": "decision",
  "title": "Fail open on timeout",
  "body": "Availability wins over strictness."
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"tone":{"type":"string","enum":["note","decision","assumption","risk"]},"title":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"body":{"type":"string","maxLength":20000}},"required":["tone"]}
```

## checklist

**Checklist.** Acceptance criteria or agreements. With `interactive: true` the user ticks items and every tick reaches you.

- Give items a stable `id` if you will reorder them; ticks are stored by id, or by position without one.

Example config:

```json
{
  "interactive": true,
  "items": [
    {
      "text": "429 has Retry-After",
      "done": true
    },
    {
      "text": "Fail-open metric",
      "done": true
    },
    {
      "text": "Per-IP on anon routes"
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"interactive":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"},"items":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":100,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][\\w.:-]*$"},"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"done":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["text"]}}},"required":["items"]}
```

## table

**Table.** Mappings, inventories, figures: anything row-shaped. The user can sort by any column. Compare options with `optionMatrix` instead, and never write a decisions table: the page lists the decisions itself.

- Every row has one cell per column. A cell is a string, a number, `null` or a badge.
- A string cell takes inline markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `inline code` and links. Block syntax stays literal, so `> 5 ms` or `1. Draft` reads as written.
- A badge cell is `{ "text": "To confirm", "tone": "attention" }`. tone: neutral | accent | attention. Use it for a status or verdict column.
- `refColumn` names the column holding question ids, which render as links.

Example config:

```json
{
  "columns": [
    "Plan",
    "Sustained",
    "Burst",
    "From"
  ],
  "rows": [
    [
      "Free",
      "60 / min",
      60,
      "Q-08"
    ],
    [
      "Team",
      "600 / min",
      300,
      "Q-08"
    ],
    [
      "Business",
      "3,000 / min",
      {
        "text": "To confirm",
        "tone": "attention"
      },
      "Q-10"
    ]
  ],
  "refColumn": 3
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"columns":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":12,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"rows":{"maxItems":500,"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","maxLength":2000},{"type":"number"},{"type":"null"},{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"tone":{"default":"neutral","type":"string","enum":["neutral","accent","attention"]}},"required":["text"]}]}}},"refColumn":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991}},"required":["columns","rows"]}
```

## stats

**Stat tiles.** One to four headline numbers. No decoration.

- tone: neutral | accent | attention

Example config:

```json

      "label": "Requirements",
      "value": 3
    },
    {
      "label": "Tasks",
      "value": 12
    },
    {
      "label": "To confirm",
      "value": 2,
      "tone": "attention"
    }
  ]
}
```

## flow

**Flow.** Request paths, pipelines, decision branches. You give nodes and edges; the page lays them out.

- direction: LR | RL | TB | BT
- A node with `emphasis: "new"` or `"changed"` is painted in the accent style: use it for the part the decision hinges on.
- `shape: "decision"` draws a diamond. An edge with `style: "dashed"` is a fallback path; label it.

Example config:

```json
{
  "direction": "LR",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "c",
      "label": "Client"
    },
    {
      "id": "l",
      "label": "Limiter",
      "emphasis": "new"
    },
    {
      "id": "h",
      "label": "Handler"
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "from": "c",
      "to": "l"
    },
    {
      "from": "l",
      "to": "h",
      "label": "has tokens"
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"direction":{"default":"LR","type":"string","enum":["LR","RL","TB","BT"]},"nodes":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":60,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][\\w.:-]*$"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"emphasis":{"type":"string","enum":["new","changed"]},"shape":{"default":"box","type":"string","enum":["box","decision"]}},"required":["id","label"]}},"edges":{"maxItems":120,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][\\w.:-]*$"},"to":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][\\w.:-]*$"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"style":{"default":"solid","type":"string","enum":["solid","dashed"]}},"required":["from","to"]}}},"required":["nodes","edges"]}
```

## sequence

**Sequence.** Who calls whom, in what order.

- `from` and `to` are indexes into `actors`. `reply: true` draws a dashed return arrow.

Example config:

```json
{
  "actors": [
    "Client",
    "API",
    "Redis"
  ],
  "messages": [
    {
      "from": 0,
      "to": 1,
      "text": "GET /orders"
    },
    {
      "from": 1,
      "to": 2,
      "text": "take token"
    },
    {
      "from": 2,
      "to": 1,
      "text": "0 left",
      "reply": true
    },
    {
      "from": 1,
      "to": 0,
      "text": "429",
      "reply": true
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"actors":{"minItems":2,"maxItems":8,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"messages":{"maxItems":60,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"to":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"reply":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["from","to","text"]}}},"required":["actors","messages"]}
```

## architecture

**Architecture.** Components inside boundaries, with labelled links.

- A node belongs to at most one group.

Example config:

```json

  "groups": [
    {
      "label": "API cluster",
      "nodes": [
        "gw",
        "lim"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Data",
      "nodes": [

    }

    },
    {
      "id": "redis",
      "label": "Redis"
    }
  ],
  "links": [
    {
      "from": "gw",
      "to": "lim"
    },
    {
      "from": "lim",
      "to": "redis",
      "label": "Lua"
    }
  ]
}
```

## state

**State machine.** The states something moves through, and why.

- `initial` is drawn with a heavier outline. States listed in `emphasis` are painted as the fallback or failure states.

Example config:

```json
{
  "initial": "allowed",
  "states": [
    "allowed",
    "limited",
    "failed_open"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "allowed",
      "to": "limited",
      "on": "empty"
    },
    {
      "from": "limited",
      "to": "allowed",
      "on": "refill"
    },
    {
      "from": "allowed",
      "to": "failed_open",
      "on": "timeout"
    }
  ],
  "emphasis": [
    "failed_open"
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"initial":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"states":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":40,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":80}},"transitions":{"maxItems":80,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string"},"to":{"type":"string"},"on":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"required":["from","to"]}},"emphasis":{"default":[],"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["states","transitions"]}
```

## schema

**Schema.** Database tables, their columns and the relations between them: what a migration adds, alters or drops.

- A table has an `id` (its heading unless you give a `name`) and its columns in order. A column has a `name`, an optional `type` and `keys` (pk | fk | uk).
- `change: "added" | "changed" | "removed"` on a table, a column or a relation paints what the change does to it.
- A relation reads from `from` to `to`. Name the columns with `fromColumn` and `toColumn` and the line joins those rows. cardinality: many-to-one (the default: a foreign key on `from`) | one-to-one | one-to-many | many-to-many.

Example config:

```json
{
  "tables": [
    {
      "id": "plans",
      "columns": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type": "uuid",
          "keys": [
            "pk"
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "name",
          "type": "text"
        },
        {
          "name": "rpm",
          "type": "int",
          "change": "added"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "api_keys",
      "columns": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type": "uuid",
          "keys": [
            "pk"
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "plan_id",
          "type": "uuid",
          "keys": [
            "fk"
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "rpm_override",
          "type": "int",
          "change": "added"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "limit_events",
      "change": "added",
      "columns": [
        {
          "name": "id",
          "type": "bigint",
          "keys": [
            "pk"
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "key_id",
          "type": "uuid",
          "keys": [
            "fk"
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "at",
          "type": "timestamptz"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "relations": [
    {
      "from": "api_keys",
      "fromColumn": "plan_id",
      "to": "plans",
      "toColumn": "id"
    },
    {
      "from": "limit_events",
      "fromColumn": "key_id",
      "to": "api_keys",
      "toColumn": "id",
      "change": "added"
    }
  ]
}
```

## c4

**C4 view.** A C4 context, container or component view: who uses the system, what it is made of, and what it talks to.

- kind: person | system | container | component | database | queue. `technology` and `description` are short lines under the label.
- `external: true` greys out an element outside the system being described. `emphasis: "new" | "changed"` paints it in the accent style.
- A boundary draws a box around the elements it lists; an element sits in one boundary at most. A relation can name its `technology` ("HTTPS").

Example config:

```json
{
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "dev",
      "kind": "person",
      "label": "API customer",
      "description": "Calls the public API"
    },
    {
      "id": "gw",
      "kind": "container",
      "label": "Gateway",
      "technology": "Node, Express"
    },
    {
      "id": "lim",
      "kind": "component",
      "label": "Limiter",
      "technology": "middleware",
      "description": "A token bucket per key",
      "emphasis": "new"
    },
    {
      "id": "redis",
      "kind": "database",
      "label": "Redis",
      "technology": "Redis 7"
    },
    {
      "id": "pager",
      "kind": "system",
      "label": "PagerDuty",
      "external": true
    }
  ],
  "boundaries": [
    {
      "label": "API platform",
      "elements": [
        "gw",
        "lim",
        "redis"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "relations": [
    {
      "from": "dev",
      "to": "gw",
      "label": "calls",
      "technology": "HTTPS"
    },
    {
      "from": "gw",
      "to": "lim",
      "label": "checks each request"
    },
    {
      "from": "lim",
      "to": "redis",
      "label": "takes a token",
      "technology": "Lua"
    },
    {
      "from": "lim",
      "to": "pager",
      "label": "pages on fail-open"
    }
  ]
}
```

## mindmap

**Mind map.** A topic broken into its parts: the scope of a change, the areas it touches, the open threads.

- The config is the centre node: a `label` and its `children`. Each child has a `label` and its own `children`, four levels deep at most, 80 nodes in all.
- Each top-level branch gets its own colour. `emphasis: "new" | "changed"` marks a node.

Example config:

```json
{
  "label": "Rate limiting",
  "children": [
    {
      "label": "Limits",
      "children": [
        {
          "label": "Per plan"
        },
        {
          "label": "Per-key override"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Storage",
      "children": [
        {
          "label": "Redis bucket",
          "emphasis": "new"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Failure",
      "children": [
        {
          "label": "Fail open"
        },
        {
          "label": "Page on-call"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Rollout",
      "children": [
        {
          "label": "Shadow mode"
        },
        {
          "label": "Free tier first"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## compare

**Before / after.** Two diagrams side by side, with the difference painted.

- Each side is the id of a flow, sequence, architecture or state block in the write-up, or an inline `{ type, config }` for one of those types. Its `label` is optional.
- highlight: added | removed | both | none. Nodes are matched by id.

Example config:

```json
{
  "left": {
    "label": "Today",
    "block": {
      "type": "flow",
      "config": {
        "nodes": [
          {
            "id": "c",
            "label": "Client"
          },
          {
            "id": "h",
            "label": "Handler"
          }
        ],
        "edges": [
          {
            "from": "c",
            "to": "h"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "right": {
    "label": "After",
    "block": "flow-proposed"
  },
  "highlight": "added"
}
```

## timeline

**Timeline.** Rollout steps, milestones, migration order.

- `current` is the index of the step in progress.

Example config:

```json
{
  "current": 0,
  "steps": [
    {
      "label": "Shadow mode",
      "detail": "log only"
    },
    {
      "label": "Free tier",
      "detail": "enforce"
    },
    {
      "label": "All tiers",
      "detail": "flag removed"
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"current":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991},"steps":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":20,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"detail":{"type":"string","maxLength":20000},"duration":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"exit":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"required":["label"]}}},"required":["steps"]}
```

## gantt

**Gantt chart.** A schedule: tasks with durations and dependencies on a time axis. For an ordered list of steps without dates or lengths, use `timeline`.

- `duration` is in days; 0 is a milestone. `start` is the date of day 0; without it the axis counts days and weeks.
- A task starts at `at` (days from the start), else when every task in `after` ends, else when the task before it ends. `after` names earlier tasks only.
- `group` puts tasks under a heading. status: done | active.

Example config:

```json
{
  "start": "2026-10-05",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "build",
      "label": "Build the limiter",
      "group": "Build",
      "duration": 10,
      "status": "done"
    },
    {
      "id": "shadow",
      "label": "Shadow mode",
      "group": "Rollout",
      "duration": 14,
      "after": [
        "build"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "free",
      "label": "Enforce on Free",
      "group": "Rollout",
      "duration": 7,
      "after": [
        "shadow"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "all",
      "label": "All tiers",
      "group": "Rollout",
      "duration": 7,
      "after": [
        "free"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "flag",
      "label": "Flag removed",
      "group": "Rollout",
      "duration": 0,
      "after": [
        "all"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"start":{"type":"string","pattern":"^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$"},"tasks":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":40,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][\\w.:-]*$"},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"group":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"duration":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":3650},"at":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":3650},"after":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":10,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":120,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9][\\w.:-]*$"}},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["done","active"]}},"required":["id","label","duration"]}}},"required":["tasks"]}
```

## bar

**Bar chart.** Compare magnitudes across a few categories. Colours come from the page, never from you.

- Each `data` row is the category label followed by one value per series.

Example config:

```json
{
  "orientation": "horizontal",
  "unit": "req/min",
  "stacked": true,
  "series": [
    "Sustained",
    "Burst"
  ],
  "data": [
    [
      "Free",
      60,
      60
    ],
    [
      "Team",
      600,
      300
    ],
    [
      "Business",
      3000,
      1000
    ]
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"orientation":{"default":"horizontal","type":"string","enum":["horizontal","vertical"]},"unit":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"stacked":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"},"series":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":6,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"data":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":40,"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":["string","number","null"]}}}},"required":["series","data"]}
```

## line

**Line chart.** A trend over time, with optional annotations.

- Every series has one value per `x`. Set `sample: true` when the numbers are illustrative, not measured.

Example config:

```json
{
  "unit": "429s per hour",
  "x": [
    "Mon",
    "Tue",
    "Wed",
    "Thu",
    "Fri"
  ],
  "series": [
    {
      "name": "Would-be 429s",
      "values": [
        12,
        18,
        15,
        22,
        19
      ]
    }
  ],
  "annotations": [
    {
      "x": "Wed",
      "text": "Limits tuned"
    }
  ],
  "sample": true
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"unit":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"x":{"minItems":2,"maxItems":200,"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","maxLength":40},{"type":"number"}]}},"series":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":6,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"values":{"type":"array","items":{"type":["number","null"]}}},"required":["name","values"]}},"annotations":{"default":[],"maxItems":20,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":["string","number"]},"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"required":["x","text"]}},"sample":{"default":false,"type":"boolean"}},"required":["x","series"]}
```

## sankey

**Sankey.** How a quantity splits and merges as it moves: traffic through a pipeline, volume by destination, cost by service.

- Each flow names its two nodes by label and carries a positive `value`. A pair flows once, and flows never loop back.
- Columns follow the flows from left to right. Colours come from the page.

Example config:

```json
{
  "unit": "req/min",
  "flows": [
    {
      "from": "Requests",
      "to": "Free",
      "value": 1200
    },
    {
      "from": "Requests",
      "to": "Team",
      "value": 3000
    },
    {
      "from": "Requests",
      "to": "Business",
      "value": 4800
    },
    {
      "from": "Free",
      "to": "Allowed",
      "value": 900
    },
    {
      "from": "Free",
      "to": "429",
      "value": 300
    },
    {
      "from": "Team",
      "to": "Allowed",
      "value": 2900
    },
    {
      "from": "Team",
      "to": "429",
      "value": 100
    },
    {
      "from": "Business",
      "to": "Allowed",
      "value": 4800
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"unit":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"flows":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":60,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":80},"to":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":80},"value":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0}},"required":["from","to","value"]}}},"required":["flows"]}
```

## riskMatrix

**Risk matrix.** Likelihood against impact, 3 x 3.

- likelihood and impact: 1 (low) to 3 (high).

Example config:

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "Limits too tight",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2
    },
    {
      "label": "Retry storms",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2
    },
    {
      "label": "Silent fail-open",
      "likelihood": 1,
      "impact": 3
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":20,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"likelihood":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":3},"impact":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":3},"mitigation":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"required":["label","likelihood","impact"]}}},"required":["items"]}
```

## optionMatrix

**Option matrix.** Options compared side by side against criteria. Use it, not a table, whenever you compare options: products, approaches, directions. Good in question context.

- One column per option, one row per criterion, and every row has one cell per option.
- A cell is a score from 0 to 3 (drawn as dots; more is better), short text, or `{ "text": "Auto-refresh only", "verdict": "bad" }`. verdict: good | mixed | bad.
- `recommended` is the index of the option you recommend; its column is highlighted.

Example config:

```json
{
  "options": [
    "Fail open",
    "Fail closed",
    "Local bucket"
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "criterion": "Uptime",
      "cells": [
        {
          "text": "Unaffected",
          "verdict": "good"
        },
        {
          "text": "Redis down is an outage",
          "verdict": "bad"
        },
        {
          "text": "Unaffected",
          "verdict": "good"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "criterion": "Protection",
      "cells": [
        {
          "text": "None while Redis is down",
          "verdict": "bad"
        },
        {
          "text": "Full",
          "verdict": "good"
        },
        {
          "text": "Per instance only",
          "verdict": "mixed"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "criterion": "Effort",
      "cells": [
        3,
        3,
        1
      ]
    },
    {
      "criterion": "Moving parts",
      "cells": [
        "None",
        "None",
        "A bucket per instance"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "recommended": 0
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"options":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":6,"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"rows":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":30,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"criterion":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"cells":{"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":3},{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":300},{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":300},"verdict":{"type":"string","enum":["good","mixed","bad"]}},"required":["text","verdict"]}]}}},"required":["criterion","cells"]}},"recommended":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":9007199254740991}},"required":["options","rows"]}
```

## fileTree

**File tree.** Files the change will add or touch.

- change: added | modified | removed | renamed

Example config:

```json
{
  "root": "src/",
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "middleware/limiter.ts",
      "change": "added"
    },
    {
      "path": "lib/redis.ts",
      "change": "modified"
    },
    {
      "path": "config/plans.yaml",
      "change": "modified"
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"root":{"type":"string","maxLength":400},"files":{"minItems":1,"maxItems":200,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"change":{"type":"string","enum":["added","modified","removed","renamed"]},"note":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"required":["path"]}}},"required":["files"]}
```

## code

**Code / diff.** A real excerpt from the repo, a proposed diff, or a snippet of code that is not in the repo yet: a new file, a config, a payload.

- mode: excerpt | diff | snippet. An excerpt names a tracked repo file and `lines` ("12-15"); the page reads the file itself, so it is never stale.
- A diff carries a unified `patch`. A snippet carries its code as `source`; `file` is optional and only titles it.
- The page highlights by `lang` (a highlight.js name such as `ts`, `json`, `yaml`, `sql`), else the file extension, else a guess, and folds by indentation, so indent code properly.

Example config:

```json
{
  "file": "src/lib/redis.ts",
  "lines": "12-15",
  "mode": "diff",
  "lang": "ts",
  "patch": "@@ -12,3 +12,4 @@\n export const redis = new Redis({\n-  maxRetries: 3,\n+  maxRetries: 1,\n+  commandTimeout: 50,\n });"
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["excerpt","diff","snippet"]},"file":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"lines":{"type":"string","pattern":"^\\d+(-\\d+)?$"},"lang":{"type":"string","maxLength":20},"patch":{"type":"string","maxLength":20000},"source":{"type":"string","maxLength":20000}},"required":["mode"]}
```

## image

**Annotated image.** A screenshot or mockup with numbered pins.

- `src` is `asset:<file>`, a file you saved under the change folder's `.planroom/assets/`.
- Pin x and y run from 0 to 1 across the image.

Example config:

```json
{
  "src": "asset:errors.png",
  "alt": "Error-rate dashboard",
  "pins": [
    {
      "x": 0.64,
      "y": 0.42,
      "text": "429s appear in this panel"
    }
  ]
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"src":{"type":"string","pattern":"^asset:[\\w.-]+\\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|svg)$"},"alt":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400},"pins":{"default":[],"maxItems":20,"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},"y":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":400}},"required":["x","y","text"]}}},"required":["src","alt"]}
```

## mermaid

**Mermaid fallback.** Escape hatch for a diagram no native block covers (a git graph, a quadrant chart). Prefer a native block when one fits.

Example config:

```json
{
  "source": "gitGraph\n  commit\n  branch limiter\n  commit\n  commit\n  checkout main\n  merge limiter"
}
```

Config schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":20000}},"required":["source"]}
```
